subject: SparkMetrics onboarding: PO process, invoice cutoff, and accelerated remit request
messages:
From: Alex Goldstein <finance@sparkmetrics.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: nina.park@sparkmetrics.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & early remit option

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking the call earlier — excited to get SparkMetrics live in your vendor portal. To accelerate our cashflow while we scale, our finance team asked whether Redwood offers an accelerated remit option (early pay) against invoices in exchange for a small discount.

Attached: SparkMetrics_W9.pdf and SparkMetrics_BankDetails.pdf.

A few onboarding clarifications from our side:
- Preferred PO format (PDF vs. EDI) and whether POs can be routed to our billing inbox automatically.
- Invoice cutoff for monthly cycles and the earliest remit date after submission.
- Any required onboarding form fields we should pre-populate to avoid delays.

If you can point us to the internal checklist or a single contact in finance/procurement, we’ll get everything over today.

Thanks,
Alex Goldstein
Head of Finance, SparkMetrics
finance@sparkmetrics.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Alex Goldstein <finance@sparkmetrics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & early remit option

Alex —

Great to hear. Welcome aboard. I’ve looped Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Procurement) to run through our PO/invoice workflow and the early remit program. High level:

- PO process: procurement issues a formal PO number once the MSA is signed. We accept PDF POs via vendor portal and by email to ap-invoices@redwood.ai; EDI can be enabled for larger partners but requires mapping.
- Invoice cutoff: default monthly cycle is invoices received by the 5th for payment in the following cycle (Net 30 from invoice date).
- Early remit: Finance runs an accelerated-pay program for strategic vendors — usually an options-based discount (0.5–2.0% depending on the term).

Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm the typical discount bands and whether SparkMetrics qualifies for our sprint remit (7-day or 14-day) pilots? Also, we usually ask vendors to complete our onboarding checklist (attached) and upload bank details to the portal for ACH.

I attached our Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx — Alex, if you can return the completed sheet plus the bank details you already attached, we can kick off setup. Also, do you need a DocuSign for the MSA or will you complete via email?

— Vivek
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Alex Goldstein <finance@sparkmetrics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & early remit option

Thanks Vivek — quick notes from Finance.

Alex, welcome. A few clarifying points so we can scope the early remit option: 
1) Discount program: we offer a tiered early-pay discount: 1.0% for net-14, 1.5% for net-7, and 2.0% for same-day/next-business-day on approved invoices. Approval requires PO matching and our AP checks completed in our portal.
2) Eligibility: typically limited to vendors on file for at least one verified invoice cycle or strategic partners. Given SparkMetrics’ volume forecast in the deal (DW-8732), we can make an exception for a pilot.
3) Requirements: completed onboarding checklist, W-9 on file, verified bank details (we perform micro-deposit validation for ACH), and signed MSA if revenue impacts exceed $50k ARR.

Operational items: please upload the completed Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and a signed W-9 to the vendor portal link below. If you prefer, I can accept attachments here but portal uploads speed the verification.

Portal link: https://vendor.redwood.ai/signup (upload AES-encrypted PDFs)
DocuSign MSA: https://docusign.com/redwood/msa/DW-8732 (if they prefer signature flow)

If you want to pilot net-7 early pay, we’ll provision a special AP queue and mark invoices for sprint processing once verified. Let us know your preferred pilot terms (net-7 or net-14) and whether you need partial up-front draw.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Goldstein <finance@sparkmetrics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: nina.park@sparkmetrics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & early remit option

Marissa — appreciate the detail. We’d like to pilot net-7 at 1.5% for the first two months while we validate volume and turnaround; that should work for us. Nina will upload the completed onboarding checklist, W-9, and the bank micro-deposit authorization form to the portal by EOD.

A couple of practical Qs:
- Is the PO number required to be on page 1 of the invoice for auto-match?
- For the pilot, will Redwood route pilot invoices to a dedicated AP mailbox so we can expedite reconciliations?

If you confirm the two points, we’ll schedule our first invoice for the pilot (target invoice date 2026-07-20).

Thanks,
Alex
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Alex Goldstein <finance@sparkmetrics.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & early remit option

Alex — quick answers:
- PO placement: yes, PO number must be in the invoice header (page 1) and in the invoice metadata field in the portal for automatic PO-match. If the PO is missing, the invoice falls to manual review and won’t be eligible for the early remit queue.
- Pilot routing: we’ll create a pilot tag and route matching invoices to ap-sprint@redwood.ai. Please CC that mailbox on the 07/20 invoice PDF upload.

Next steps summary:
1) Alex/Nina upload completed checklist + signed W-9 + bank micro-deposit auth to the vendor portal by EOD 7/15 (noted they will).
2) Redwood provisions pilot (net-7 @1.5%) and creates ap-sprint@redwood.ai queue.
3) SparkMetrics submits invoice dated 2026-07-20 with PO on page 1 and CCs ap-sprint@redwood.ai.

I’ll update PROC-452 with the queue details and close the loop once applied.

— Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
